en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from one of his companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one who is fair with the people from himself, would be pleased with judging for others’.
en.sarwar: 12. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn Mahbub from certain individuals of his people from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Whoever yields to justice for people against his own soul is accepted to judge others’ cases.”
